reflection_steps.finding: The app-server lane mesh completed v5 x1 for Cicero, Kierkegaard, and Aristotle.
The CLI lane pair remains monitored but not duplicated while final-message files are absent.
The Arby/Aster poll used a five-window timeout and preserved the open gap honestly.
A running watcher process is not itself progress; final-state files remain the acceptance signal.
Existing app threads remain the safe route; no new old-style sibling spawning occurred.
The command book can now be treated as a graph input with field completeness checks.
Live and connector commands are routed to future exact-approval review rather than direct execution.
Skill metadata is useful for routing without publishing or mutating skill bodies.
Plugin cache remains read/use-only in this ordinary THOS phase.
The 30 system, 30 command, and 30 skill proposals were classified by safe probe tier.
Proposal-only status prevents inflated claims about installed capabilities.
Thirty-two current searches were performed, with official sources emphasized.
The source ledger separates query coverage from reviewed URL evidence.
Codex 0.136.0 and app-server documentation remain directly relevant to lane reliability.
MCP authorization and tool specifications map cleanly to connector approval boundaries.
Push protection and Actions hardening support exact-stage publication discipline.
Sandbox readiness must remain observed; Microsoft docs provide vocabulary, not proof of local success.
Execution policy belongs in hygiene guidance, not as a hard security guarantee.
List-form subprocess calls and temp lifecycle controls are now embedded in helper design.
OpenTelemetry signals give a schema language for v5 x2 watcher dashboards.
Compose watch reinforces file-triggered runner design but does not replace Codex watcher evidence.
Job/CronJob semantics support idempotence and duplicate-start avoidance.
Vertex AI, Agent Engine, RAG, and vector search are architecture context only.
DGX Spark, NIM, Nemotron, and Omniverse are capacity and simulation context only.
The v49 Journey file is present locally and remains continuity context, not canon proof.
v54/v55 handoff material remains metadata-carried and not bulk imported.
All six GMUT gates remain open across the THOS output set.
Every artifact in this phase must pass JSON parse, compile, guard, and exact staging.
The correct next phase is v477 THOS v5 x2, not v478 or v490 yet.
The long v490 objective stays active because this is one verified step, not completion.
